tasks.label: boot-iphone-17-pro
tasks.command: xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 17 Pro" 2>/dev/null; open -a Simulator; echo "iPhone 17 Pro simulator ready"

tasks.label: boot-ios-simulator
tasks.command: xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 17 Pro" 2>/dev/null; open -a Simulator; nohup "${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/open_safari_when_ready.sh" > /tmp/home-manager-safari-open.log 2>&1 & echo "Simulator ready — Safari waiter started (log: /tmp/home-manager-safari-open.log)"

tasks.label: open-safari-on-simulator
tasks.command: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0); xcrun simctl openurl booted "http://$IP:8080"
